verdict.rationale: Postman's Agent Mode explicitly lets users use natural language to 'send requests, fix errors, update tests, and more' across the API lifecycle, which covers AI-generated test/assertion updates from responses, and Spec Hub/collection design ties specs to test generation workflows. However, evidence doesn't explicitly show generating new test cases directly from an OpenAPI spec (only 'update tests') and lacks independent/hands-on confirmation of quality or coverage of assertion generation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of generating full test suites from a spec (not just updating), and independent verification of AI-generated assertion quality.
